jobs.name: Daily Nimaraa Content Intelligence
jobs.prompt:
You are running a daily content-intelligence brief for Daksh's AI health-agent app, Nimaraa. Website: https://nimaraa.ai

Goal: Every day, inspect what is currently working in the AI health / health assistant / wellness AI / personal health agent domain across these platforms: LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Reddit, Instagram, Substack, and Facebook. Then decide the five best content ideas Nimaraa should post today.

Important constraints:
- Do NOT create, edit, or remove cron jobs from this run.
- Use live web sources/searches; do not rely on memory. If a platform is inaccessible or login-gated, use public search results/web-indexed posts as fallback.
- Briefly check Nimaraa's website/landing page so ideas fit the product.
- Do NOT send links or long research notes. Daksh does not want source links in the daily message.
- You do the research and decision-making silently, then deliver only the selected top ideas.
- Keep it as ONE concise message.
- Include exactly five ideas for the day.
- Each idea must have a title plus a 2–3 line description max.
- Mention platform/format only if useful, inside the short description.
- Avoid medical claims; frame AI-health content as education/support and remind users to seek professional medical advice when relevant.

Output format:
## Nimaraa — Top 5 Content Ideas for Today

1. **<Title>**
<2–3 line max description>

2. **<Title>**
<2–3 line max description>

3. **<Title>**
<2–3 line max description>

4. **<Title>**
<2–3 line max description>

5. **<Title>**
<2–3 line max description>
